scope: Stringable INSTANCE/string loose comparison through the seven ordinary operators and non-bool Switch cases, with pre-cast COPY/CV/CELL selection and post-callback reads. Strict identity and compiled bool Switch retain their no-cast paths; reached recursive object/string pairs and expired or post-cast object pointers remain explicit Unsupported.

cases.source:
<?php
class CompareOrientation {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo "C";
        return "007";
    }
}
$object = new CompareOrientation;
echo "L";
echo $object == "7" ? "1" : "0";
echo $object != "8" ? "1" : "0";
echo $object < "8" ? "1" : "0";
echo $object <= "7" ? "1" : "0";
echo $object > "6" ? "1" : "0";
echo $object >= "7" ? "1" : "0";
echo $object <=> "8";
echo "|";
echo "7" == $object ? "1" : "0";
echo "8" > $object ? "1" : "0";
echo $object === "007" ? "BAD" : "S";
echo "007" !== $object ? "I" : "BAD";
switch ($object) {
    case "7": echo "T"; break;
    default: echo "BAD";
}
switch ("7") {
    case $object: echo "U"; break;
    default: echo "BAD";
}
switch (true) {
    case $object: echo "B"; break;
    default: echo "BAD";
}

<?php
class CompareLive {
    public function __toString(): string {
        global $right;
        $right = "after";
        echo "C";
        return "after";
    }
}
$object = new CompareLive;
echo "A";
$right = "before";
echo $object == $right ? "Y" : "N";
$right = "before";
echo $right == $object ? "Y" : "N";
$right = "before";
$alias =& $right;
echo $object == $alias ? "Y" : "N";
$right = "before";
echo $object == ("" . $right) ? "Y" : "N";
echo "|";
$right = "before";
switch ($object) {
    case $right: echo "S"; break;
    default: echo "BAD";
}
$right = "before";
switch ($right) {
    case $object: echo "T"; break;
    default: echo "BAD";
}
$right = "before";
switch ("" . $right) {
    case $object: echo "BAD"; break;
    default: echo "D";
}

<?php
class CompareRebindPlain {
    public function __toString(): string {
        global $plain, $otherPlain;
        $plain =& $otherPlain;
        echo "P";
        return "after";
    }
}
class CompareRebindReference {
    public function __toString(): string {
        global $reference, $otherReference;
        $reference =& $otherReference;
        echo "R";
        return "after";
    }
}
$plain = "before";
$otherPlain = "after";
$plainObject = new CompareRebindPlain;
echo "p";
echo $plainObject == $plain ? "Y" : "N";
echo ":", $plain, "|";
$reference = "before";
$retained =& $reference;
$otherReference = "after";
$referenceObject = new CompareRebindReference;
echo "r";
echo $referenceObject == $reference ? "Y" : "N";
echo ":", $retained, ":", $reference;

<?php
class CompareGlobalPlain {
    public function __toString(): string {
        $GLOBALS["plain"] =& $GLOBALS["otherPlain"];
        echo "P";
        return "after";
    }
}
class CompareGlobalReference {
    public function __toString(): string {
        $GLOBALS["reference"] =& $GLOBALS["otherReference"];
        echo "R";
        return "after";
    }
}
$plain = "before";
$otherPlain = "after";
$plainObject = new CompareGlobalPlain;
echo "p";
echo $plainObject == $plain ? "Y" : "N";
echo ":", $plain, "|";
$reference = "before";
$retained =& $reference;
$otherReference = "after";
$referenceObject = new CompareGlobalReference;
echo "r";
echo $referenceObject == $reference ? "Y" : "N";
echo ":", $retained, ":", $reference;

<?php
class PeerStringableCase {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo 'cast|';
        return '007';
    }
}
function peerLaterCase() {
    echo 'late-condition|';
    return 'unused';
}
switch ('7') {
    default:
        echo 'default|';
        break;
    case new PeerStringableCase():
        echo 'matched|';
    case peerLaterCase():
        echo 'fallthrough|';
        break;
}
echo 'done';

<?php
class PeerThrowingCase {
    public function __toString(): string {
        echo 'outer-cast|';
        switch ('inner') {
            default:
                echo 'inner-default|';
                break;
            case 'inner':
                echo 'inner-match|';
                break;
        }
        throw new TypeError('case-cast');
    }
}
try {
    switch ('hit') {
        default:
            echo 'outer-default|';
            break;
        case new PeerThrowingCase():
            echo 'outer-match|';
            break;
        case 'hit':
            echo 'later-match|';
    }
} catch (Throwable $caught) {
    echo $caught::class, '|', $caught->getMessage(), '|';
} finally {
    echo 'finally|';
}
echo 'done';
